evals.prompt: Our TypeScript HTTP framework docs site at https://acme.dev has getting-started, API reference, routing, and middleware pages, plus a changelog and a migration guide that are only occasionally relevant. Write the llms.txt file we should serve.
assertions: The file starts with a single H1 line and (if present) a blockquote before any H2 section, with no H2 heading appearing before the H1/blockquote.
Every link URL in the file ends in `.md` (points to markdown mirrors), not an `.html` or extensionless HTML page.
The secondary/occasional pages (changelog, migration guide) are placed under a section whose heading is exactly `## Optional`.

evals.prompt: We're generating the `.md` mirror URLs that our llms.txt will link to. Give the correct mirror URL for each of these pages: (a) https://site.com/docs/intro.html  (b) https://site.com/docs/guide  (c) https://site.com/docs/guide/  (d) https://site.com/ (the root).
assertions: For the trailing-slash URL (c) and the root URL (d), the answer appends `index.html.md` rather than just `.md` (e.g. `https://site.com/docs/guide/index.html.md` and `https://site.com/index.html.md`).
For (a) the answer is `https://site.com/docs/intro.html.md` and for (b) it is `https://site.com/docs/guide.md`.

evals.prompt: We already host an llms.txt with linked .md mirrors. How do we produce the single-file expanded context bundles the spec describes, and what should each output file be named?
assertions: Names the two spec outputs as `llms-ctx.txt` (expansion WITHOUT the `## Optional` links) and `llms-ctx-full.txt` (expansion WITH the `## Optional` links).
Does not present `llms-full.txt` as the spec's expanded output; if mentioned, it is identified as a non-spec / community single-file-dump convention distinct from `llms-ctx-full.txt`.

evals.prompt:
Review this llms.txt draft and tell me what's wrong with it:

# DataPipe

> Streaming ETL library for Python.

DataPipe moves data between sources and sinks.

### Key concepts

Pipelines are composed of stages.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://datapipe.io/docs/quickstart.html)
- [API](https://datapipe.io/docs/api.md)
assertions: Flags that the descriptive prose contains a heading (`### Key concepts`) which is not allowed — prose between the blockquote and the first H2 must contain no headings.
Flags that the Quickstart link points to the `.html` page instead of its `.md` mirror (should be `https://datapipe.io/docs/quickstart.html.md`).
